description.en: Drag a retro computer to unplug its springy power cord, or tap the screen to cycle through four CRT tints.
description.zh: 拖动复古电脑，电源线拉紧后脱开。轻点屏幕可轮换四种 CRT 色调。

keywords: 复古 电脑 电源线 拔插 插座 拖拽 弹簧 显像管 换色 手写 悬浮预览 retro computer macintosh power cord unplug reconnect CRT tint drag portfolio

useCases: 作品集开场中的复古电脑交互

instructions.en: Drag the computer until the cord unplugs, then use Reconnect or the outlet. Tap the computer to cycle the screen tint.
instructions.zh: 拖动电脑拔掉电源线，点击 Reconnect 或插座重新接通。轻点电脑切换屏幕色调。
